summary: Rooftop shop car park in West End's busy centre, with homes beyond the sides.
reasons: Pin is on a shop roof, deck is east

drivers.seclusion: Deck sits behind the Boundary Street frontage; nearest dwelling 26 m west, houses and apartments 48 to 60 m away, church and shops closer.
drivers.access_and_room: Pin lands on a shop roof, so I judged the open car deck 15 to 25 m east, with several cars parked. Entry ramp not visible.
drivers.traffic: Busy main road and traffic lights 40 to 60 m north; noise and pedestrians likely.
drivers.convention: Shopper parking in a commercial centre with no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Possible entry barrier or time limit
Slope figures come from the pin, which is on a building; the deck looks flat
sun_shade: Open deck in sun; the buildings to the west shade it in the late afternoon.
cannot_judge: Access ramp, barrier and height clearance

best_section.where: Rooftop deck of the shopping block, just east of the pin
